question: The Paramhansa Sabha was founded in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1849**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Paramhansa Sabha was founded in **1849** in Maharashtra as a secret socio-religious reform society.
 
• It was started by **Dadoba Pandurang**, along with his associates, with the aim of promoting social and religious reforms.
 
• The Sabha focused on **abolishing caste discrimination** and promoting equality within society.
 
• It emphasized the study of religious texts, spreading knowledge, and creating a sense of brotherhood among people.
 
• The Sabha played a crucial role in laying the foundation for later reform movements, such as the **Prarthana Samaj**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dadoba Pandurang Tarkhadkar:** A key figure in the socio-religious reform movement in Maharashtra, known for his efforts in promoting liberal thought and education.
 
• **Prarthana Samaj:** Inspired by the Paramhansa Sabha, this organization was later founded in 1867 with a focus on social reform and religious rationalism.
 
• **Social Reform Movements in India:** The 19th century saw a wave of reform movements aimed at eradicating social evils like caste discrimination, child marriage, and sati.
 
• **Secret Societies for Reform:** Many early reform initiatives, like the Paramhansa Sabha, operated in secrecy to avoid opposition from orthodox sections of society.
 
• **Legacy of Paramhansa Sabha:** It influenced other reform movements and became a precursor to organizations advocating for equality, education, and rationalism in India.
